explication: iMCP exposes personal-data and device capabilities as MCP tools through a macOS menu-bar app. An MCP client launches the bundled stdio server; it discovers the app over Bonjour and proxies the client connection to the app’s MCP server. The app requests approval, dispatches enabled tool calls to service implementations, and returns results to the client. Users enable services and tools in the app, which also supports configuring Claude Desktop. Service capabilities are taken from the README; unsampled service implementations are represented by their listed source paths, without inferring their internal API wiring.
